policy: Public-safe curated shortlist only. It contains bibliographic metadata, plain-language relevance, evidence level, and publication status; it excludes operational logs, local paths, prompts, credentials, and private review detail.

selection.rule: Show up to four directly relevant papers. A fourth paper is shown only when its direct relevance is at least 80/100; the interface never pads a shortlist with a weaker paper.
